editorial.blurb: Ja' Grill brings vibrant Caribbean and American flavors to Hyde Park with generous portions, lively atmosphere, and staff that genuinely cares.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive hungry and ask your server for honest portion guidance—the oxtail and chicken curry are known for their size, and you'll want to pace yourself.
signatureDishes: Chicken curry with rice, lentils, and vegetables
